desc: Sort arrays A, B, C in descending order.
Implement a max-heap based approach to generate the largest values of $A_i B_j + B_j C_k + C_k A_i$ one by one.
Use a set to keep track of visited $(i, j, k)$ tuples to avoid duplicates.
Pop the largest value from the heap K times; the K-th popped value is the answer.
Handle edge cases where indices go out of bounds.
